excerpt: MND 545: Virtual Reality Storytelling Meets: Tues/Thurs, 3:45-5:05 p.m. in person | Class #18030 Fall 2022 Semester. Open to any Syracuse University student! Learn the foundational skills needed for effective STORYTELLING IN THE METAVERSE in this hands-on skills course taught by Prof. Dan Pacheco, a global leader in the use of Virtual and Augmented Reality for journalistic storytelling. What is the metaverse? It’s bigger than just Facebook, though the company is heavily invested through its Oculus VR ecosystem and changing its company name to “Meta.” All the top tech companies are investing millions or even billions into building the foundations of Web 3.0, a successor to the Internet that is promised to be 3D, immersive and social — much of it accessed through augmented glasses, headsets, and even neural interfaces. Investment bank Citi projects the metaverse to be a $13 trillion economy by 2030. How does your content live in that future, and what do you need to know how to build to be an effective journalist, film maker, advertiser or storyteller? Get your digital edge on the future by learning these foundational metaverse skills: - 360 video production using 8K cameras. - 3D scanning / photogrammetry. - Creating interactive CGI scenes. - Coding XR using A-Frame. - Motion capture and character animation. - Social VR with Mozilla Hubs. - Augmented Reality with Adobe Aero. - Immersive storytelling techniques. - Immersive media ethics. Prerequisite / Co-requisite There are no prerequisites for this course other than being in a communications-related degree program. Students from other degrees may petition to get in, provided they explain how they will use the skills they gain for the purposes of communication within their intended jobs. Mode of Instruction The physical presence of students is required in a physical campus location. Audience This course is for students in professional communications degrees such as journalism, television, film, advertising and public relations who want to learn about how to tell stories using virtual and augmented reality. Description This production-oriented course teaches students in communications fields how to tell stories interactively using 360-degree video and computer-generated scenes that subjects experience through leading virtual reality headsets.
